title: EUI/MAC/IID helpers accept lists and return mutable bytearray
description:
## Problem

python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py make_link_local() and native_address_from_pubkey() require type(x) is bytes so mutable buffers cannot be identity material. The EUI/MAC/IID helpers in the same file only check len():

- eui64_to_iid / iid_to_eui64: int.from_bytes accepts an iterable of 0..255, so eui64_to_iid([0]*8) silently returns the U/L-flipped IID. A JSON array of 8 ints therefore becomes a real address. str of length 8, bool, and None raise TypeError, not AddrError. A list with a value outside 0..255 raises ValueError.
- mac48_to_eui64(bytearray(6)) returns a bytearray (slice + bytes stays bytearray). The caller can mutate that object after derivation. mac48_to_eui64('123456') raises TypeError.
- address_from_prefix(IPv6Network('0200::/64'), '12345678') raises TypeError on concat; bytearray IID is accepted.

short_addr_to_iid in this file already uses type(x) is int (pony). Tests never pass a list or bytearray into the EUI helpers.

## Why it matters

Same class as 8jel/pony: a JSON/CBOR value of the wrong type does not fail closed. Mutable EUI-64 from mac48_to_eui64 is the opposite of the immutable-bytes rule make_link_local already enforces. LCI client_link_local type-checks before calling, so the hole is the public helper, not that one caller.

## Where

python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:77-82 eui64_to_iid
python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:85-90 iid_to_eui64
python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:93-101 mac48_to_eui64
python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:119-125 address_from_prefix
design: Mirror make_link_local / native_address_from_pubkey: require type(x) is bytes before len(). mac48_to_eui64 must return bytes even if a future caller passes a bytes subclass; construct with concatenation into bytes() or explicit bytes slices. Do not accept bytearray, memoryview, or list. Map remaining TypeError/ValueError from int.from_bytes to AddrError only after the type guard; with type is bytes those should not fire.
acceptance_criteria: eui64_to_iid, iid_to_eui64, mac48_to_eui64, and address_from_prefix raise AddrError for True, None, str of the right length, bytearray, memoryview, and a list of the right length. mac48_to_eui64(bytes MAC) still returns bytes (not bytearray) matching RFC 4291 FF-FE insertion without U/L flip. eui64_to_iid(SPEC_EUI64) still equals SPEC_IID. Existing vector tests stay independent-oracle.
